review: independent read-only review: OK. Every former field was an immutable let and PendingInput has no conformances, key paths or identity checks; one Derived per init as before (single construction site); the explicit init keeps the memberwise labels; the _read accessors borrow lets of a final class (no copy, no dynamic exclusivity check); Storage is immutable apart from Derived's own lock. Notes: first _read accessors in the package (underscored but supported by every toolchain used); cross-module reads go through a coroutine call (not on hot paths).
